subject: Great American Beer Hall Hours Extension
overview: The City Council approved several common victualler licenses, including a contested hours extension for the Great American Beer Hall subject to noise mitigation conditions. The council also approved over $2.3 million in capital stabilization fund appropriations for municipal vehicles, city hall renovations, and cemetery expansion design.

items.title: National Recovery Month Resolution
items.summary: The council approved a resolution celebrating National Recovery Month and heard from the city's recovery coach and social services coordinator regarding local support resources.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: The council voted to table the records of the August 5th meeting.

items.title: Resolution on Protecting Dependents of Deported Residents
items.summary: The council referred a resolution to hold a committee meeting on methods to protect dependents of residents deported by federal officers to the Committee on Public Health and Community Safety.

items.title: Resolution on Local Social Service Resources
items.summary: The council referred a resolution to discuss local and state resources for vulnerable residents amid federal cuts to the Committee on Public Health and Community Safety.

items.title: Grant of Location Petition - National Grid
items.summary: Following a public hearing, the council approved a petition from National Grid to install a new gas main on Boston Avenue.

items.title: Common Victualler's License - CB Scoops
items.summary: The council approved a common victualler's license for CB Scoops under new ownership.

items.title: Common Victualler's License Amendment - Great American Beer Hall
items.summary: The council approved an amendment extending the operating hours for Great American Beer Hall, subject to noise mitigation conditions and subsequent reviews.

items.title: Common Victualler's License - Locolito
items.summary: The council approved a common victualler's license for Locolito to operate a new coffee shop in Medford Square.

items.title: Common Victualler's License - Inspire Cafe
items.summary: The council approved a common victualler's license for Inspire Cafe at the Medford Public Library.

items.title: Common Victualler's License - Sidebar
items.summary: The council approved a common victualler's license for Sidebar to operate the concession stand at the LoConte Ice Rink.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Fund Appointment
items.summary: The council approved the appointment of Teda DeRosa to the Board of Trustees for the Medford Affordable Housing Trust Funds.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appointment
items.summary: The council confirmed the reappointment of Myisha Majumder to the Community Preservation Committee.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: The council approved appropriations from capital stabilization funds totaling over $2.3 million for municipal vehicles, cemetery design, ADA bathroom renovations, and water and sewer projects.

items.title: Executive Session - Litigation Strategy
items.summary: The council voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy concerning Teamsters Local 25 and subsequently reconvened in open session.

items.title: Proposed Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: The council tabled proposed zoning amendments for corridor districts pending a renewed contract with the city's zoning consultant.

items.title: Tree Committee Ordinance
items.summary: The council voted to table the Tree Committee Ordinance to allow for additional legal review.

items.title: Resolution Supporting the FAIR Act
items.summary: The council approved a resolution expressing support for state legislation known as the FAIR Act to protect workers from the impacts of artificial intelligence surveillance and automation.

items.title: Resolution on Inclusionary Zoning Fractional Payments
items.summary: The council referred a resolution to update inclusionary zoning laws to allow fractional payments to the planning and permitting committee and the Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board.

items.title: Payment of Claim - Judith Dean
items.summary: The council approved a payment of $3,448.36 to resolve Judith Dean's claim for out-of-pocket costs resulting from a sewer backup.

items.title: Food Truck Permit - Chicken and Rice Guys
items.summary: The council approved a food truck permit for Chicken and Rice Guys to operate at the Mystic River Celebration on September 27, 2025.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident expressed concerns regarding an offensive sign posted at the New England Baptist Church and requested that the council investigate auditing the church's tax-exempt status.
